note: Rewritten to the claim that survived the four independent audits.

problems.original_statement: Prescriptions differ from dispensings and dispensings differ from ingestion; diagnostic codes differ from clinical events; death and care received outside the system may be incompletely captured. Methods for outcome misclassification in electronic health records increasingly use validation samples and probabilistic phenotypes. Emulation pipelines almost universally do not: a phenotype is thresholded to a binary variable at the start and treated as truth thereafter. Differential misclassification then interacts with weighting and with time-varying confounding in ways that are not intuitive, because an error in the exposure at one time propagates into the weights at every later time, and no standard analysis propagates the phenotype uncertainty at all.
problems.correction_note: The propagation mechanism was stated too loosely. An erroneous weight factor persists in the cumulative weights of clones that remain at risk, and artificial-censoring membership changes only when the mismeasured variable enters the strategy, the eligibility rule or the censoring rule; those are different channels. The entry also implied that a pipeline must accept probabilistic inputs natively, when a deterministic pipeline embedded in multiple imputation, posterior draws or a bootstrap achieves the same propagation.
problems.statement: Prescriptions differ from dispensings and dispensings differ from ingestion; diagnostic codes differ from clinical events; death and care outside the system may be incompletely captured. When a treatment, a time-varying confounder, an eligibility criterion or an outcome is a latent clinical state and the emulation analyzes an error-prone thresholded proxy as though it were fixed, differential longitudinal misclassification distorts several things at once. An erroneous weight factor persists in the cumulative weights of every clone that remains at risk. Artificial-censoring membership changes as well, but only where the mismeasured variable enters the strategy, the eligibility rule or the censoring rule. Without validation information and assumptions that identify a joint measurement model and transport it to the analysis population, measurement bias and confounding bias cannot be uniquely separated. Emulation pipelines threshold at the start and propagate none of this.
problems.why_open: The interaction is nonlinear: misclassification of a time-varying confounder biases the weight and changes who is censored, so the bias does not decompose into a measurement part and a confounding part without further assumptions. Validation samples that would calibrate a phenotype are usually convenience samples from one site, and transporting a sensitivity and specificity across sites is itself an untested transport claim. Propagation is achievable without rebuilding the pipeline, by embedding a deterministic analysis in multiple imputation, posterior draws or a bootstrap, which makes the absence a matter of convention rather than of capability.
problems.proposed_direction: Propagate phenotype uncertainty by embedding the existing deterministic pipeline in multiple imputation, posterior sampling or a bootstrap over the measurement model, which requires no new estimator and produces an interval that reflects the measurement. Develop validation-subsample targeted learning and Bayesian latent-class g-formula models for the cases where that is not enough, and state the transport assumption when a validation sample from one site calibrates another. Simulate sensitivity and specificity from 0.70 to 0.99 with differential misclassification odds ratios from 1 to 4, reporting bias in the estimated regime effect rather than in the phenotype, and establish how large a validation sample must be before the correction is worth its variance cost.
